task.title: The "Move to..." dialog in the desktop app isn't visible
task.description: The selection tray for cards to move is rendered at the bottom of the desktop app window. When I click the "Move to..." button I expect to see a UI element to select where to move the cards, but it seems to be rendering below the page window, with no scroll option. I see a small line at the bottom of the page appear, suggesting the top of a selection box.
